Name: Ho Chak Sing | Hans

Summary:
Portfolio for an engineer who builds AI infrastructure and distributed evaluation systems: distributed control planes,
lease-based work claiming, state machines and crash recovery, closed-book agent evaluation harnesses, runtime
verification, and the C++/Python systems performance work underneath them.

Topics:
- distributed control planes and worker lifecycle
- lease-based claiming, generation fencing, crash-safe recovery
- AI agent evaluation infrastructure and falsifiable oracles
- runtime verification and anti-fake-green verdicts
- MCP servers and agentic tool orchestration
- C++ systems performance and deterministic execution

Notable result:
Holding an evaluation pipeline fixed and swapping only the author of the grading test moved the measured pass rate
from 27.5% (tests written by the original human developer) to 65.6% (tests the agent wrote for itself), meaning
self-authored benchmarks overstate agent performance by roughly 2.4x. Reproduced across two data generations.
